verified_claims: The draft inventories identity, rank/MMR, Memory/Log, match/CV, generated text/media, imported child views, capture, and audio surfaces with fail-closed handling for unknown or failed masks.

Calibration source references identify the opt-in command, default-off behavior, local artifact path and fallback, full-screen PNG screenshots, GIF/keyframe PNG clips, and audit context; the draft does not claim these are stream-masked or viewer-safe.
Unreviewed FullOverlay/CommandDeck children and external viewer capture remain unresolved gates, and a separate named Privacy Owner must accept the exact contract hash.
The draft records the delegated policy to preserve latency-critical G-Signal warnings for the player and makes no viewer-audio safety claim.

product_owner_decision.player_warning: Preserve latency-critical G-Signal warnings for the player. Stream formatting or mode must never suppress or delay them.
product_owner_decision.viewer_audio: Do not claim the player warning is inaudible to viewers; inspected sources do not establish isolation from broadcast capture.
product_owner_decision.safe_mode: Keep safe mode BLOCKED_SAFE and unavailable for ON_SAFE until a player-versus-viewer audio/capture isolation option is defined and tests demonstrate both the isolation boundary and continued player-warning availability within the latency target.
product_owner_decision.route_selection: No specific implementation route is selected because the inspected sources do not evidence an isolated local-audio path. This is a policy-level block condition, not implementation authority.
product_owner_decision.privacy_owner: A separate named Privacy Owner must accept the exact hash and viewer-audio/capture behavior; this Product Owner disposition is not Privacy Owner acceptance.

limitations: This is a draft product/privacy contract only. No G-Stream implementation, audio routing, screenshot/capture change, or runtime mode exists or is approved here.
No audio-isolation, capture, masking, child-view, screenshot, or latency test was run. Local calibration storage does not establish masking, retention/deletion, export, or viewer safety.
